<STBG 5,0><BGM 0,0,504><MWT 5><COL FEEB4EFF><COL FEEB4EFF>Ranbai Island's relic</COL>: the tablet's
text is deciphered, so I record it here.

<MWT 4>「The offered shark's chalice:
a blood pact offered to the gods;
its golden treasure heals impurity.」

<MWT 4>The relic, the shark's chalice —
I would like to drink from it once.
